subject.title: feat: add Pioneer.ai as an inference provider with live model discovery

question: Should OpenClaw officially own and publish the Pioneer provider, or should Pioneer remain a community ClawHub plugin while the generic catalog and TUI fixes are handled separately?
rationale: Code review can assess the implementation, but only maintainers can commit the project to official provider ownership, release publishing, documentation, and ongoing API support.

options.title: Sponsor Official Provider
options.body: Accept Pioneer as an official external provider, then authorize or internally regenerate the dependency graph and validate upgrade behavior before merge.

options.title: Route Through ClawHub
options.body: Keep Pioneer community-owned on ClawHub and split the generic external-catalog and TUI picker corrections into a provider-neutral PR.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Official Provider
recommendation.body: Accept Pioneer as an official external provider, then authorize or internally regenerate the dependency graph and validate upgrade behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice determines official package ownership, publication, and provider product scope across the repository.
